A gentleman, noteworthy for a lively countenance and a waistcoat to match it, crossing London Bridge at noon on a gusty April day, was almost magically detached from his conflict with the gale by some sly strip of slipperiness, abounding in that conduit of the markets, which had more or less adroitly performed the trick upon preceding passengers, and now laid this one flat amid the shuffle of feet, peaceful for the moment as the uncomplaining who have gone to Sabrina beneath the tides.

75551-reminiscences-of-the-south-seas.title: Reminiscences Of The South Seas
75551-reminiscences-of-the-south-seas.creator: Unknown
75551-reminiscences-of-the-south-seas.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. San Francisco was the same place, with the same curious feeling of its being cold while one felt the heat; but there was neither place, time nor anything for me; there were things to buy and replace--all sorts of things had been forgotten, and now more than ever I realize that it is well to be overloaded--even if I believe that later I should feel it.

arxiv-1511-05185.title: Mixture model of pottery distributions from Lake Chad Basin archaeological sites reveals ancient segregation patterns
arxiv-1511-05185.creator: John D. O’Brien, Kathryn Lin, Scott MacEachern
arxiv-1511-05185.description:
A 2015 arXiv research paper by John D. O’Brien, Kathryn Lin, Scott MacEachern. Abstract

We present a new statistical approach to analyzing an extremely common archaeological data type – potsherds – that infers the structure of cultural relationships across a set of excavations. This method, applied to data from a set of complex, culturally heterogeneous sites around the Mandara mountains in the Lake Chad Basin, articulates currently understood cultural succession into the Iron Age.

arxiv-2011-01808.description: Abstract The Bayesian approach to data analysis provides a powerful way to handle uncertainty in all observations, model parameters, and model structure using probability theory. Probabilistic programming languages make it easier to specify and fit Bayesian models, but this still leaves us with many options regarding constructing, evaluating, and using these models, along with many remaining challenges in computation.

arxiv-2208-09552.title: Snowmass’21 Discussions on Future Accelerator HEP Facilities
arxiv-2208-09552.description: Abstract The US particle physics community planning exercise (a.k.a. “Snowmass”) is organized every 7 to 9 years to provide a forum for discussions among the entire particle physics community to develop a scientific vision for the future of particle physics in the U.S. and its international partners.

arxiv-2212-06116.title: Stable vortex structures in colliding self-gravitating Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-2212-06116.creator: Y.O. Nikolaieva, Y.M. Bidasyuk, K. Korshynska, E.V. Gorbar, Junji Jia, A.I. Yakimenko
arxiv-2212-06116.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Y.O. Nikolaieva, Y.M. Bidasyuk, K. Korshynska, E.V. Gorbar, Junji Jia, A.I. Yakimenko. A key feature of ultra-light dark matter composed by bosons is the formation of superfluid Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) structures on galactic scales. We study collisions of BEC solitonic and vortex structures in the framework of the Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson model. It is found that the superfluid nature of bosonic dark matter leads to the formation of quantized vortex lines and vortex rings in interference patterns formed during collisions.

arxiv-2303-02083.title: Many-Body Theory Calculations of Positron Scattering and Annihilation in H 2 , N 2 and CH 4
arxiv-2303-02083.creator: C. M. Rawlins †, J. Hofierka †, B. Cunningham, C. H. Patterson, D. G. Green
arxiv-2303-02083.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by C. M. Rawlins †, J. Hofierka †, B. Cunningham, C. H. Patterson, D. G. Green. The recently developed ab initio many-body theory of positron molecule binding [J. , Nature, 606, 688 (2022)] is combined with the shifted pseudostates method [A. A 101, 022702 (2020)] to calculate positron scattering and annihilation rates on small molecules, namely H 2 , N 2 and CH 4 . The important effects of positron-molecule correlations are delineated.

arxiv-2311-17079.title: A statistical mechanical analysis on the possibility of achieving fair cylindrical dice
arxiv-2311-17079.creator: M. N. C. Brustelo, M. M. Vivaldi, F. Marques
arxiv-2311-17079.description: Abstract Many have dedicated their time trying to determine the ideal conditions for a cylinder to have equal probabilities of falling with one of its faces facing upwards or on its side. However, to this day, there is no concrete analysis of what these conditions should be.

arxiv-2407-05351.title: Single-shot labeling of quantum observables
arxiv-2407-05351.creator: Nidhin Sudarsanan Ragini, Mario Ziman
arxiv-2407-05351.description: Abstract We identify and study a particular class of distinguishability problems for quantum observables (POVMs), in which observables with permuted effects are involved, which we call as the labeling problem . Consequently, we identify the binary observables those can be “labeled” perfectly. In this work, we study these problems in the single-shot regime.

arxiv-2505-06498.title: An In-kernel Forensics Engine for Investigating Evasive Attacks
arxiv-2505-06498.creator: Javad Zandi, Lalchandra Rampersaud, Amin Kharraz
arxiv-2505-06498.description: Abstract Over the years, adversarial attempts against critical services have become more effective and sophisticated in launching low-profile attacks. This trend has always been concerning. However, an even more alarming trend is the increasing difficulty of collecting relevant evidence about these attacks and the involved threat actors in the early stages before significant damage is done.

arxiv-2505-23657.title: Active Layer-Contrastive Decoding Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Model Generation
arxiv-2505-23657.creator: Hongxiang Zhang, Hao Chen, Muhao Chen, Tianyi Zhang
arxiv-2505-23657.description: Abstract Recent decoding methods improve the factuality of large language models (LLMs) by refining how the next token is selected during generation. These methods typically operate at the token level, leveraging internal representations to suppress superficial patterns. Nevertheless, LLMs remain prone to hallucinations, especially over longer contexts.

arxiv-2508-11811.title: Frequentist Cosmological Constraints from Full-Shape Clustering Measurements in DESI DR1
arxiv-2508-11811.creator: H. Zou
arxiv-2508-11811.description: Abstract We perform a frequentist analysis using the standard profile likelihood method for clustering measurements from Data Release 1 of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI). While Bayesian inferences for Effective Field Theory models of galaxy clustering can be highly sensitive to the choice of priors for extended cosmological models, frequentist inferences are not susceptible to such effects.

arxiv-2509-01244.title: An affinity based opinion dynamics model
arxiv-2509-01244.creator: for the evolving pattern of political polarization
arxiv-2509-01244.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by for the evolving pattern of political polarization. Abstract

Political polarization has been a subject that has attracted many studies in recent years. We have developed an opinion dynamics model with affective homophily effect and national social norm effect to describe this phenomenon.

arxiv-2510-01611.title: PsychCounsel-Bench: Evaluating the Psychology Intelligence of Large Language Models
arxiv-2510-01611.creator: Min Zeng
arxiv-2510-01611.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success across a wide range of industries, primarily due to their impressive generative abilities. Yet, their potential in applications requiring cognitive abilities, such as psychological counseling, remains largely untapped. This paper investigates the key question: Can LLMs be effectively applied to psychological counseling?

pmc-10743261.title: Phase-Specific Damage Tolerance of a Eutectic High Entropy Alloy
pmc-10743261.creator: Shristy Jha, Rajiv S Mishra, Sundeep Mukherjee, Reza Abbaschian
pmc-10743261.description: Phase-specific damage tolerance was investigated for the AlCoCrFeNi2.1 high entropy alloy with a lamellar microstructure of L12 and B2 phases. A microcantilever bending technique was utilized with notches milled in each of the two phases as well as at the phase boundary.

pmc-11353823.title: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis and Miliary Tuberculosis in an Apparently Immunocompetent Patient: A Case Report
pmc-11353823.creator: Filippo Ducci, Francesca Mariotti, Jessica Mencarini, Claudio Fabbri, Alessandra Francesca Manunta, Daniela Messeri, Paola Parronchi, Pierluigi Blanc, Alessandro Bartoloni, Nicola Petrosillo
pmc-11353823.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a serious haematologic condition that can be related to various diseases, including tuberculosis (TB). The patient is a previously healthy 26-year-old man, originally from western Africa, admitted to hospital for fever and weight loss. Given the results of a computed tomography (CT) scan, ocular examination and microbiologic tests, miliary TB with pulmonary, lymph nodal and ocular involvement was diagnosed.

pmc-11457466.title: Evidence-based guidelines for the interpretation of the 9-item Concise Health Risk Tracking – Self-Report (CHRT-SR9) measure of suicidal risk
pmc-11457466.creator: Karabi Nandy, Rajesh Ranjan Nandy, A John Rush, Taryn L Mayes, Madhukar H Trivedi
pmc-11457466.description: Background:The 9-item Concise Health Risk Tracking – Self-Report (CHRT-SR9) is a widely used patient-reported outcome measure of suicidal risk. The goal of this article is to provide an evidence-based interpretation of the CHRT-SR9 total score in terms of four clinically actionable categories of suicidal risk (none, mild, moderate, and severe).

pmc-11574909.title: Generalized type II minocycline-induced pigmentation: A case report
pmc-11574909.creator: Wumei Zhao, Haijing Fu, Tianyi Xu, Shi-Jun Shan
pmc-11574909.description: Minocycline-induced pigmentation is a rare dermatological condition that primarily affects the skin and thyroid gland, oral mucosa, nails, teeth, bones, and sclera leading to grayish-blue pigmentation in these areas. Early identification, discontinuation of the drug, and laser treatment are crucial in managing this condition.

pmc-11634867.title: The prognostic value of neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio in adult carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae infection: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11634867.creator: Zhongjie Wang, Renhua Li, Zhe Yuan, Zuli Zhang, Keli Qian
pmc-11634867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundSystemic inflammatory indicators such as neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) can effectively predict the prognosis of various inflammatory diseases. However, its prognostic effect on patients with carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP) infection is little known.

pmc-11641526.title: Beyond Intention: Barriers to Undergoing a Blood Pressure Check in the South-West Shewa Zone, Ethiopia
pmc-11641526.creator: Bezawit Ketema, Mirgissa Kaba, Mosisa Bekele, Eva Johanna Kantelhardt, Eric Sven Kroeber, Adamu Addissie, Ines Aguinaga-Ontoso
pmc-11641526.description: Background/Objectives: Hypertension is often asymptomatic, progresses slowly, and leads to multiple secondary diseases. Thus, a regular blood pressure check is recommended. The objective of this study is to assess the intention to undergo a blood pressure check and its associated factors among adults in Southwest Shewa Zone, Ethiopia. Methods: A healthcare-facility-based cross-sectional design was utilized.

pmc-11709248.title: Ligand identification in CryoEM and X-ray maps using deep learning
pmc-11709248.creator: Jacek Karolczak, Anna Przybyłowska, Konrad Szewczyk, Witold Taisner, John M Heumann, Michael H B Stowell, Michał Nowicki, Dariusz Brzezinski, Lenore Cowen
pmc-11709248.description: MotivationAccurately identifying ligands plays a crucial role in the process of structure-guided drug design. Based on density maps from X-ray diffraction or cryogenic-sample electron microscopy (cryoEM), scientists verify whether small-molecule ligands bind to active sites of interest. However, the interpretation of density maps is challenging, and cognitive bias can sometimes mislead investigators into modeling fictitious compounds.

pmc-11726746.title: Characterization of Metallo β-Lactamase Producing Enterobacterales Isolates with Susceptibility to the Aztreonam/Avibactam Combination
pmc-11726746.creator: Brunella Posteraro, Flavio De Maio, Teresa Spanu, Maria Alejandra Vidal Pereira, Francesca Romana Fasano, Maurizio Sanguinetti, Vasiliki Koumaki, Efthymia Protonotariou
pmc-11726746.description: Background/Objectives: Metallo-β-lactamases (MBLs) in Enterobacterales and other Gram-negative organisms pose significant public health threats due to their association with multidrug resistance (MDR). Although aztreonam (AZT) can target MBL-producing organisms, its efficacy is compromised in organisms expressing additional β-lactamases that inactivate it. Combining AZT with the β-lactamase inhibitor avibactam (AVI) may restore its activity against MBL-producing isolates.

pmc-13242015.title: From school climate to brain development: What the ABCD study reveals about the educational context of adolescence☆
pmc-13242015.creator: Erin L Thompson, Oliver M Sawi, Ethan A Roy, Shermaine Abad, Christine M Kaiver, Sarah M Lehman, Jolene Tay, Marybel R Gonzalez, Amandine Van Rinsveld, Gayathri J Dowling, Sandra A Brown, Terry L Jernigan, Bruce D McCandliss, Elizabeth A Hoffman
pmc-13242015.description: Children and adolescents spend much of their time in school, and educational environments are central to neurodevelopment and socioemotional health. However, educational constructs are often underrepresented in developmental cognitive neuroscience research. The Adolescent Brain Cognitive DevelopmentSM (ABCD) Study provides an unprecedented opportunity to examine schooling within a large, diverse, longitudinal cohort with rich neuroimaging and socioenvironmental data.
